gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-rowan: Conthrax opens its lowercase a wide and makes the bodies so large that capitals barely rise above them, all geometric and clean. Rowan's generous curves then carry text along like a single thread.
gen-dafont-existence-fs-neco: Neco is a dignified serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, and its curves never pinch shut. Existence, with portholes for counters, earns its keep in large, brief lines.
gen-dafont-franchise-fs-neco: Neco carries a dignified, authoritative voice with a measured swell in each stroke. Franchise packs its letters shoulder to shoulder, and that crowded punch against Neco's open curves is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-franchise-fs-recia: Franchise jams its letters against their neighbors, strong and clean, with crossbars matching the stems in weight. Recia, with light modulation and generous openings, gives that crowding room to breathe.
gen-dafont-franchise-lora: Franchise jams its letters against their neighbors, yet the curves of its c pull their tips well apart. Lora, bookish and literary with only modest hairline thinning, lets the text relax after that compression.
gen-dafont-gobold-noto-serif: Noto Serif brings a literary, universal voice with a subtle swing between heavy and light strokes. Noto Serif against Gobold's open-ended curves and far-apart letters is where the pair is most striking.
gen-dafont-helsinki-fs-quicksand: Clean and marker-plain, Helsinki stretches its line of text sideways, one simple stroke after another. And Quicksand, its bowls like blown glass bulbs, shares that plain drawing habit, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-helsinki-general-sans: Wide, marker-plain lettering: Helsinki stretches sideways while General Sans fills the line with a steady pen pressure. And giving Helsinki a generous size lets General Sans stay modest below.
gen-dafont-hero-fs-asap: Asap draws its c forms as open arcs and keeps the body height close to the capitals. And if Hero is made small, its closed, bent-tubing letters and wide sweep lose their presence next to Asap.
gen-dafont-klill-fs-epilogue: Wire-thin and loose, Epilogue's monoline curves share Klill's big-bodied lowercase and its lack of thick-thin shift. And paragraph after paragraph, Epilogue's stubby ascender tips and loose curves keep the text approachable.
